summary: Server-side Budget Alerts backend fully verified. 21/21 pytest cases pass (auth gating, prefs GET/PUT normalization, evaluate-budget 80/100/dedupe, 50 only when enabled + dedupe, evaluate-transaction large/dedup/polarity/missing-id, prefs.off suppression with no dedup-slot leak, notification inbox list + unread-count + mark-read + mark-all-read, push relay resilience with placeholder key returning 500 'Push key missing or invalid' without crashing server, spoof check returning 403, threshold logic independent of push failure with delivery_status='failed' persisted, and regression smoke on /api/auth/me, /api/user/membership, /api/plaid/status). No fixes needed. Deterministic evaluators are correct and idempotent.
critical_code_review_comments: push_service.py: module-level httpx.AsyncClient is created at import time and pinned to the placeholder key value; if EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is rotated at runtime, the client will still use the old value. Not blocking today but worth a lazy factory pattern.

notifications_router.py: PATCH /notifications/{id}/read returns 404 only when the record is missing OR not owned by the user (good). Consider returning the updated read_at in the response for client sync, currently only {ok:true}.

budget_alert_service._emit persists a notification even when push delivery upstream 401s — this is correct for the design (in-app inbox is source of truth), and delivery_status='failed' is correctly recorded, but no retry queue exists yet.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Test fixture cleans the test user's alert_state, notifications, and alert_prefs before the run so each execution is isolated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_budget_alerts.py is reusable regression. It logs in as push+test1@jaleter.app (registers if missing, else logs in, else falls back to alex+test1@jaleter.app) and wipes the user's alert_state/notifications/alert_prefs before each run. Uses unique sub_ids per test to keep dedup semantics clean. Push relay tests assume EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder; if that changes the upstream 401 assertion will need adjustment.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all P0 behaviors verified. Threshold logic is deterministic (100% > 80% > 50% precedence within one tick), dedupe via alert_state composite _id works, prefs.off does not consume dedup slots, push failures do not block notification creation, spoof user_id in /api/register-push correctly returns 403.
